image_description: The Heuvel Galerie first opened its doors in 1992. This shopping mall, designed by the German architect Walter Brune, is located right at the heart of Eindhoven's center. It accommodates more than a hundred shops, cafés and restaurants. The Heuvel Galerie is totally covered, easily accessible and can be reached directly from the underground car park
